entities.name: HIV-1 Env gp160
observations: 768-aa sequence strongly matches HIV-1 group M subtype B Env gp160 (82.1–82.6% identity; near-full query coverage to reviewed UniProt references).
Env is processed by host furin-like protease into gp120 and gp41; mature Env forms a trimer of gp120-gp41 heterodimers and mediates CD4/coreceptor attachment and membrane fusion.
Sequence-derived mass is approximately 87.1 kDa and theoretical pI is 8.78; these estimates do not account for glycosylation or processing.
Pfam detects GP120 domains at residues 33–145 and 140–502, and GP41 at residues 521–710; type-I membrane topology is supported by homolog annotation and a C-terminal hydrophobic membrane anchor.
